string.text: Traitor Pigeon
You suspected the assassination mission and started an investigation. You are waiting for reports from your scouts to locate the looter parties carrying out provocations in your name... (1 Day)

You suspected the assassination mission and started investigating. You must find and defeat 3 different looter parties wandering around using the name {PlayerName}. The truth will be revealed when you interrogate their scouts.
You are interrogating the captured looters in isolation... Wait for them to break and reveal the location of their ringleader. (1 Day)
Traitor Looters
It is time to interrogate the captives. You must go to a nearby looter party (Field Coordinator) and speak with them.
The captives told you the whereabouts of their ringleader. If you wait a bit, the real pigeons will come to you.
You found out who the real traitor is. Now all you have to do is pledge your allegiance to the kingdom.
We were sent by a looter in the field. Release our friends, and we will bring the looter to speak the truth.
Tell me what you know, or I will put you all to the sword!
We are just field operatives. The artisan tells us who to target. But the real boss will be here soon. Let us bring him to you!
Alright, I'm letting you go. You're of no other use anyway. I'll be waiting for your ringleader.
Looter Ringleader
Halt! We are not here to draw swords... You released my soldiers. I am a looter field coordinator. What is the meaning of this? Are you trying to tell us something?
Yes, I stand before you to prove I didn't kill the man we call our friend. I need to find out who started these slanderous rumors.
No, I have no more business with you looters. I wasn't going to execute someone I don't even know for you.

Kill? Then you are not the traitor among us... The real traitor is that rabid dog {ArtisanTarget_Link} who gave you the order. Your true mission should have been to return to the Motherland and offer your services.
You passed an unexpected test, pigeon. You've more than proven your reliability. Farewell.
Treason of the Motherland

The mysterious barber's words haunt your mind. An old friend from your motherland, {Dost_Link}, has asked the secret society 'Scavenger Pigeons' for help to fight against terrible slanders that will ruin your reputation. However, before the Pigeons accept you, you must prove your strength. Use the gold you were given to gather a company of 70 men and meet with the village elder {KoyBuyugu_Link}.

You spoke with the village elder {KoyBuyugu_Link}. As expected, this was no ordinary task. He gave you a piece of leather with secret ciphers on it and told you to deliver it to the artisan {ArtisanTarget_Link} in the city of {UzakSehir_Link} without wasting any time.
The Scavenger Pigeons' sage, {ArtisanTarget_Link}, gave you an assassination mission. You accepted it without question. Your target: {Dost_Link}.

The Pigeons have asked you to kill {Dost_Link}, the person they previously said was your friend. Inconsistent and strange things are happening. You objected to the mission during your conversation with {ArtisanTarget_Link}. You might want to urgently speak to someone about your suspicions.

{ArtisanTarget_Link} has been slandering you behind your back. When he gave you that suspicious assassination mission, you should have spoken to someone. Your name is quickly being tarnished among the looters. You have no choice but to retreat to a dark corner and wait, perhaps there is another way to solve this.
You must be the traitor. You are the one who slandered me. Prepare to die! You fought {Dost_Link}. There is no turning back!
Executing someone has never led to anything good. The Pigeons have declared you a traitor. For your motherland, you are now an open enemy. They hate you. It shouldn't have been like this...
You spoke with the looter and learned your true mission. They will deal with the traitorous Artisan. Now you must speak with the Kingdom Leader {Kral_Link} and find a way to offer your services.
You proved yourself and joined the kingdom. Now it is time to find the person who slandered you and take your revenge. {Dost_Link} is waiting to speak with you. Talk to him and learn the details.

You learned that all of this was a game set up to test your loyalty. It turns out you have just met your friend {Dost_Link}. He gave you 50,000 denars as compensation for the troubles he caused and wished you success in your new service. The rumors of treason have ended.

You saw through the treachery of {ArtisanTarget_Link} and executed him on the spot. Searching his corpse, you discovered the mysterious Raven Bone Cipher. The chapter of the motherland has closed in blood, but the eyes of the Shadow Roost are now upon you.
The barber directed me to you regarding the matter of {Dost_Link}.
Your name must be {PlayerName}, isn't it?
I guess I should get used to everyone knowing my name.
You must be a pigeon too...

Yes, of course... Your friend {Dost_Link} sent word about you. You are here for the next step. What you will do now is take this special leather containing secret information to the artisan named {ArtisanTarget_Link} in the city of {UzakSehir_Link}.
What does this have to do with my problem?
Everything is connected.
Alright, I will do it.
Safe travels, looter...
Thank you, pigeon...
A pigeon sent you this leather.
Ahh, another conspiracy! Tell me looter, what is your name?
Does a baby pigeon return to its nest?
It returns.
It does not return.
Does it not return?
Of course! So, do you seek justice or revenge?
Justice must be served! For its greatness is eternal.
My revenge will ensure that justice is manifested.
An eye for an eye, blood for blood. REVENGE, REVENGE!!
Alright, we have come to a conclusion. The treason of the motherland will end with your iron fist. Your current mission is to execute the person named {Dost_Link}.
What?! I was told this man is my friend. This is absurd, you are hiding something. I will not do this!
At your command! The looter's order is the pigeon's duty, if you'll excuse me...
The bird that fouls its nest doesn't get its wings clipped, it gets its neck snapped! (Execute the Artisan)
I have a special matter to discuss with you.
I have a special matter to discuss with you.
My friend, you came early. You haven't entered the service of the motherland yet.
Death comes early when you least expect it.
The looter wants your head. Careful not to depend on my mercy.
What nonsense are you speaking? They take orders from me. That means there's a traitor among them who thinks they tricked you!
You're right, what was I thinking. I will speak to the village elder for you.
It was a terrible encounter my friend. Watch yourself. We shall meet again.
Yes. You must be the traitor. You are the one who slandered me. Prepare to die!
We must talk about {ArtisanTarget_Link}.
Your return is an unexpected development. Is there a problem?
{ArtisanTarget_Link} gave me the name {Dost_Link} to kill.
The artisan asked me to kill the man who is supposed to be our friend.
Kill? Our friend at that? Are you certain of this? Why should I believe you? The person you accuse is a valuable looter.
You are right. You might not want to believe me. But you should know that I will not fulfill this mission.
I don't care. I won't kill anyone. Nor will I bother trying to convince you!
I am sorry, yes! You are not lying. How many times has this happened... That man is a traitor!
Maybe it's none of my business, but if you want, I can handle that man for you...
That man! Thought he could use me, eh? Now I will show him...
No! This is not your affair. Go and show your dedication to serving your motherland before it's too late. That should have been your mission. Now I must leave. Your service will not be forgotten.

{PLAYER.NAME}! Finally you have sworn allegiance to {Kral_Link}. I wanted to meet with you as well. There was never any slander against you to begin with. I staged this game to convince you to enter the service of the motherland. There was no traitor. We weren't even old friends.
Indeed! I already knew that I didn't know you. In fact, serving the Motherland was always on my mind.
Don't think you fooled me. I already wanted to walk this path myself. The slander was just the icing on the cake.
Looter's Word: What If It's True?

You encountered looters and one said your reputation is in danger. You were told to go to the barber in {GizemliSehir_Link} to learn the truth. Even though you put them to the sword, the seed of doubt grew within you. Find the barber in {GizemliSehir_Link} and ask 'What is the name of the looter?'.

You found the barber and asked him 'What is the name of the looter?'. He told you about the slanders against you. An old friend from your motherland asked for your help from the secret cult 'Scavenger Pigeons', of which he is a member. They gave you some money and told you to gather a party of 70 men and find the elder of a nearby village.
{PlayerName}! I finally found you. Being a looter is really hard.
What is this nonsense, how do you know my name, you honorless scum?!

Listen, this isn't some ordinary looter's foolish deception attempt, alright? Your reputation is in danger. I am a friend of a friend from your motherland. If you value your reputation, go to the barber of the second nearest city and ask 'What is the name of the looter?'. He will provide you with intel.
A pathetic battle tactic. (Attack)
Nice try. You've got tactical talent.
You believe me. I knew it!
Perhaps... Either way, out of respect for your cunning deception, I will spare you.
We shall see...
Every word spoken carries weight. Even so, the head of an honorless looter cannot remain on his shoulders! (Attack)
What is the name of the looter?
Anubis. Looters are the most suspicious birds of the realm. What did you want, stranger?
The mysterious man dressed as a looter I spoke to said my reputation is in danger. I hope you aren't mocking me.
The looter told me my reputation is in danger. What does this mean?

Ahh, {PlayerName}... Your suspicious behavior is, of course, very justified. Don't worry. You did very well to believe him and come here. Your friend from your motherland, {Dost_Link}, contacted us. He mentioned that they started spreading rumors behind your back that could declare you a traitor.
Who are you people? What kind of cult is this? Couldn't that idiot just send a regular messenger? Besides, I don't even know this man. Stop playing games.
You? Are you a secret society? What is your problem?

Don't worry friend. We are the Scavenger Pigeons, serving for centuries. We are faster than any messenger, stronger than any servant. Your friend is a brave man who has helped us a lot. He vouched for you and asked us to save you from this conspiracy.
What do you want from me?
As a token of our sincerity, we are gifting you some gold. Gather 70 men and find the village elder in the nearest village.
I don't want your money. I'll also have to think a bit about taking a company of 70 men there.
Thank you. I will gather that company with this money and meet with the village elder.
Alright, see you later, baby pigeon...
A Lesson in Reputation from a Looter

The mysterious man dressed as a looter told you that you needed to go to the barber in the city of {GizemliSehir_Link}. Out of respect for his deception skills, you released him and his crew. Perhaps there is some truth to his words? Go to the city of {GizemliSehir_Link} and find the barber.

You found the barber and asked him 'What is the name of the looter?'. He told you about the slanders against you. An old friend from your motherland, {Dost.Name}, asked for your help from the secret cult 'Scavenger Pigeons', of which he is a member. They gave you some money and told you to gather a party of 70 men and find the elder of a nearby village.
What is the name of the looter?
Anubis. Looters are the most suspicious birds of the realm. What did you want, stranger?
The mysterious man dressed as a looter I spoke to said my reputation is in danger. I hope you aren't mocking me.
The looter told me my reputation is in danger. What does this mean?

Ahh, {PlayerName}... Your suspicious behavior is, of course, very justified. Don't worry. You did very well to believe him and come here. Your friend from your motherland, {Dost_Link}, contacted us. He mentioned that they started spreading rumors behind your back that could declare you a traitor.
Who are you people? What kind of cult is this? Couldn't that idiot just send a regular messenger? Besides, I don't even know this man. Stop playing games.
You? Are you a secret society? What is your problem?

Don't worry friend. We are the Scavenger Pigeons, serving for centuries. We are faster than any messenger, stronger than any servant. Your friend is a brave man who has helped us a lot. He vouched for you and asked us to save you from this conspiracy.
What do you want from me?
As a token of our sincerity, we are gifting you some gold. Gather 70 men and find the village elder in the nearest village.
I don't want your money. I'll also have to think a bit about taking a company of 70 men there.
Thank you. I will gather that company with this money and meet with the village elder.
Alright, see you later, baby pigeon...
Severed Ties
You are waiting for news about the traitorous looter {HainZanaatkar_Link}. You hope he will soon pay the price for trying to deceive you.
You received an urgent, blood-stained message from a pigeon. Your friend {Dost_Link} needs to see you immediately. Find him and ask what the emergency is.

You spoke to {Dost_Link}. He revealed that the artisan {HainZanaatkar_Link} is a traitor who stole the Pigeon ciphers and fled. To find his main convoy, you must first intercept and defeat 3 of his decoy looter parties roaming the lands before they disperse. (Time Limit: 10 Days)
Traitor's Convoy
After defeating the decoys, the traitor's looter convoy has appeared to eliminate you! Confront them and retrieve the ciphers before they escape across the border. (Time Limit: 5 Days)

You destroyed the convoy and executed the traitor {HainZanaatkar_Link}. The recovered ciphers were returned to {Dost_Link}. Impressed by your unwavering devotion, your old contact welcomed you into the deeper ranks of the realm's shadow service, promising to call upon you for four seasons of service.

You accepted the artisan's bribe and allowed {HainZanaatkar_Link} to vanish into the wilderness. You gained 25,000 gold and the Pigeon's Secret Dagger. Moments later, a dying black pigeon delivered the artisan's final cryptic message: {Dost_Link} is playing everyone; the Black Ledger hidden in the ciphers will burn Calradia. The hunt for the truth has begun!

The traitor {HainZanaatkar_Link} and his convoy managed to slip across the border before you could intercept them. The secret ciphers are lost forever, and the Scavenger Pigeons have lost their trust in you.
I received your bloody pigeon message. What is the emergency?
It's a disaster, my friend! The artisan, {HainZanaatkar_Link}... The one who gave you the fake assassination order. He wasn't just playing a role. He's a real double agent!
What did he do?
He stole our master ciphers and fled the city. He's planning to sell them to the enemy. He gathered a massive looter convoy to escort him. We must stop him before he crosses the border!
Tell me what to do.
Hunt down his decoy looter parties. Destroy three of them. This will force his main convoy out of hiding. I am counting on you, Pigeon.
So, {PlayerName}... You actually found me. I am {HainZanaatkar.Name}. You Pigeons are truly relentless.
Give me the ciphers, traitor. Your death will be quick.

Wait! You blindly fight for {Dost_Link} and the Motherland. Do you even know what these ciphers contain? They are false-flag assassination orders to start an unjustified war! The Motherland is corrupt, my friend. Let me go, and I will give you a fortune and my legendary dagger.
The poisoned tongue of a traitor cannot deceive me. The Motherland's justice will be served! Men, attack! (Fight)
False-flag wars and puppet masters? Hand over the 25,000 gold and that dagger, and disappear across the border. (Accept Bribe & Let Escape)
A wise decision... The Pigeons are blind fools, but you have eyes to see. Take the gold and the dagger. Farewell, {PlayerName}!
Call of the Shadow Roost

You spared the Deep Wing courier and read the secret orders signed by {Dost.Name}. Knowing {Dost.Name}'s hounds are already hunting you, lay low and wait for the Shadow Roost to make contact... (1 Day)

As the alert faded, a black-feathered pigeon landed under your cloak. The inner circle awaits the bearer of the Raven Bone Cipher. Travel to {GolgeSehri_Link} and speak with the Shadow Whisperer {GolgeUlagi_Link}.

{GolgeUlagi_Link} revealed that {Dost.Name} is selling realm defense secrets to foreign powers to ignite another lucrative war. Intercept and annihilate the 50-man foreign detachment {RakipAjanlar_Link} waiting near {GolgeSiginagi_Link}!

You annihilated the foreign detachment and seized the stolen defense blueprints. The Shadow Roost now trusts your resolve to dismantle {Dost.Name}'s corrupt empire. You received the Shadow Bone Dagger and 30,000 denars.
You carry the Raven Bone Cipher given by our courier... So you chose truth over {Dost.Name}'s gilded lies.
I bring the Raven Bone Cipher. The courier said you know the truth behind {Dost.Name}'s wars.

The artisan was not merely a thorn; he was selling our deepest cipher archives to foreign kingdoms. You ended his breath, yet your blind loyalty must be proven by blood. A detachment of 50 foreign deserters waits near {GolgeSiginagi_Link} to purchase the stolen ciphers. Slay them all. Leave no tongue to tell the tale.
{Dost.Name}'s treason ends here. None of those foreign agents will leave that mountain alive. (Accept Mission)
Blood Ciphers & The Great Purge
To strip {Dost_Link} of his power, you must sever his financial and underworld networks. Track down his corrupt war-profiteer {Muhbir1_Link} and silence him forever.
{Muhbir1_Link}'s war chest is closed. Now seek out {Dost_Link}'s underworld enforcer {Muhbir2_Link} in the slums and dismantle his assassination ring.
{Muhbir2_Link}'s 30 mercenary enforcers ({CeteMuhafizlari_Link}) have ambushed you in the back streets! Cut through them to complete the underworld purge.
Cornered and furious, your former patron {Dost_Link} has raised an army ({DostOrdusu_Link}) to wipe you out. Confront his host on the battlefield and end his reign of deceit!

You broke {Dost_Link}'s army and executed the corrupt mastermind on the battlefield. The false wars are avenged, and the Shadow Roost awaits you for the final reckoning. You received 50,000 denars and 50 renown.
You... You are the blade who turned against {Dost.Name}! What do you want from me? I only financed the grain blockades because he ordered it!
I am here regarding the ciphers you purchased.
What?! Who sent you?! Was it the courier cabal?! Please, I burned all the ledgers, take anything you want, spare my life!
Your blood money starved entire provinces. The realm demands justice! (Execute the Financier)
Hand over the vault keys first, then face your doom. (Extort 15,000 denars & Execute)
You think you can purge the alleys, Pigeon? You murdered the merchant, but you won't leave this den breathing! Boys, gut this dog!
The Shadow Roost requires your silence, gang master.
My silence? The only silence you will find in this alley is six feet under! Boys, carve this wretch up!
Shadows swallow the alleys. Die! (Attack)

{PLAYER.NAME}... When I look at you, I no longer see an ally, but a bloodthirsty cult monster! The artisan was a traitor, but he was to face a court of law. You butchered him like a dog and became a slave to the Shadow Roost! I will wipe you from these lands!
We meet again, {Dost.Name}. It seems our paths end here.
Ever since you didn't kill that traitor, my eyes were upon you... You shall pay for your betrayal with your life!
You are weak, {Dost.Name}. Your courts, your kings, and your lies only protect the weak. Pigeons do not soar in the skies, they feast above tombs. Draw your sword!
Puppeteer of Calradia

With {Dost.Name}'s corrupt network dismantled, the ancient founder of the Shadow Roost summons you. Travel to {TunekSehri_Link} to meet the Blind Master {KorUsta_Link} and decide the ultimate fate of the Scavenger Pigeons and Calradia.
You set the roost ablaze! {KorUsta_Link}'s 40 fanatic guards {FanatikMuhafizlar_Link} surround you in fury. Annihilate them and break the chains of the cult!

The Blind Master's breath ceased under your fingers. The Shadow Master Ring now gleams upon your hand. While Calradia's kings sit pompously upon their thrones, each morning they will wake to a raven feather beneath their pillow, reminding them who truly rules Calradia from the dark.

As the Shadow Roost collapsed in flames, you walked away without looking back. The ciphers turned to ash, the puppeteers perished. Now, bound to no cult and no crown, you ride across Calradia with the Pigeon Blood Claymore as a free legend.

That very night, false pigeons cooed inside imperial palaces. By morning, empires declared war upon one another. Cities fell to siege, villages burned, and across this continental inferno, you hold the 200,000 denars and armies to tear down dynasties as you please.
The smell of smoke and spilled blood... You have climbed to the highest perch, little pigeon. Calradia's crowns tremble in silence.
I have come to face the master of the roost.
So much blood, such unfaltering blind loyalty... You have arrived at the summit, little pigeon. Calradia's crowns tremble before us. What is your will?
You forgot the first rule you taught me, Master: 'The sharpest beak cracks the oldest roost.' From now on, I give the orders! (Poison the Blind Master & Claim the Shadow Throne)
You are no mastermind; you are a sewer rat lurking in the dark! No motherland, no honor, only lies and slaughter. This roost burns tonight! (Torch the Roost & Slaughter the Fanatics)
The world does not seek order, Master. The world hungers for fire! I have dispatched the forged decrees to the monarchs of Calradia. At dawn, war horns shall sound! (Unleash Continental War)
So you have finally come out of the shadows, {Dost.Name}.
Ever since you refused to cut down that traitor artisan, my eyes have never left you... You will pay for your betrayal with your life!
Your surveillance ends here, {Dost.Name}. The Motherland was never your puppet stage!
You speak of betrayal, yet you manufactured wars for profit and called it patriotism.
Then let us end this. No more games, no more false ravens. Come at me, if you dare.

Profit? No, you blind fool! Order! While kings played their games of crowns, I kept Calradia from tearing itself apart! And you, you threw away everything for the word of a runaway artisan and a pack of shadow fanatics!
The Black Ledger tells a different story. Village massacres under false banners. Grain hoards built on fabricated famines. This is your 'order'.
If you truly served the realm, why did you need me to kill your own artisan? What was he going to expose?

He saw too much! A craftsman playing at philosophy, imagining himself the conscience of the realm. I built this network with blood and sleepless decades. No artisan's sentimentality was going to unravel it! And now you stand in the threshold of my roost, blade in hand, thinking yourself a hero? You are nothing but the last loose thread I must trim.
Then trim it, {Dost.Name}. Or die trying!
{Dost.Name}. Stand down. You are outnumbered and your network is exposed. This ends without more bloodshed.

Trial? Ha! I taught those council lords everything they know about surviving a trial. But perhaps... perhaps there is a final move on this board. Forgive me, old friend. Some games have only one ending.
It is over, {Dost.Name}. The roost falls with you.
Secret Pigeon Dagger
Raven Bone Cipher
Shadow Bone Dagger
Shadow Master Ring
Pigeon Blood Claymore
The Black Ledger
I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
I have returned, friend.
Thank you. The donation I'm about to make will compensate for the trouble I've caused you and help you in your new service.
May your blade serve the realm well. Farewell, friend.
I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
Ah, {PlayerName}! I sent my swiftest pigeon after you. Thank the heavens we crossed paths.
I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
A double agent? How could someone in the inner circle breach our security like that?
First you told me he was testing me, now you claim he is a traitor. How do I know who to trust?
Enough hand-wringing. What did he take, and what is the bounty on his head?

He held the master cipher archive, the true identities of every operative we planted across all kingdoms! Before dawn, he murdered two keepers and slipped through the gates. If he delivers those scrolls to the enemy, hundreds of our people will be rounded up and executed.
If our informants are exposed, will the high lords brand us as conspirators rather than protectors?
He spent decades serving the Pigeons. What could possibly drive an elder craftsman to such reckless treachery?

Gold, fear, and paranoia! He claims our society has become too powerful and orchestrates false wars. But he is a hypocrite, he gathered a convoy of 70 cutthroat looters to guard his escape. He is marching toward the border passes right now.
Seventy looters with baggage can move fast. How do we pin them down before they slip through the passes?
Let him hire a thousand cutthroats. My blade will cut through his vanguard like straw. Where do I strike?

He deployed three decoy looter bands across the foothills to confuse our tracking hounds. Intercept and destroy those three decoy parties. Once his decoys are crushed, his main convoy will lose its screen and be forced to face you in the open.
Consider it done, friend. I will bring back the master ciphers and end this treason. (Accept Hunt)
I will ride him down. But make sure the Motherland remembers who saved her throat today. (Accept Hunt)
Why run like a common thief? Why steal the very ciphers you swore to protect?
Save your breath, rat. Hand over the master ciphers and get on your knees.
You gathered 70 looters and spent a fortune to flee. What is in those ciphers that makes you run for your life?

You speak of theft, but you don't even know whose blood is on your hands! You think you are fighting for the Motherland and your noble friend {Dost.Name}. But you are nothing more than his blinded executioner!
{Dost.Name} warned me you would spew poison. You're selling our defense archives to foreign crowns to save your own hide!
Whose blood? What did you discover in those master ciphers that made you turn against your own brothers?

Defense archives? Lies! These ciphers contain the Black Ledger, the secret record of every false-flag raid {Dost.Name} orchestrated! He hires deserters to slaughter frontier villages under rival banners, forcing kings into wars so the Pigeons can sell protection and intelligence at extortionate prices!
Manufactured wars... Is that why you gave me an assassination contract against {Dost.Name} when we first met?
Even if {Dost.Name} is ruthless, you are surrounded by 70 looters. Why should I trust a runaway looter over a kingdom lord?

Yes! I tried to have him killed to save Calradia from another continental bloodbath, but you refused! Now my only desire is to live. Let me cross this border, {PlayerName}. Take my 25,000 gold and my Pigeon's Secret Dagger. {Dost.Name} will never know. You can walk away wealthy and unburdened!
Your dagger and your gold will be mine once your corpse hits the dirt anyway. Draw your steel! (Fight)
The Black Ledger & The Web of Shadows

A dying black pigeon collapsed onto your campfire, its claws clutching a scorched parchment written in the fugitive artisan's trembling hand: '{Dost.Name} is not serving the Motherland; he is turning it into an abattoir. The Black Ledger detailing every manufactured war and staged assassination is hidden in {GizliSehir_Link}. Find the broker {KaraMuhbir_Link} before the silencers bury the truth.'

A dying black pigeon collapsed onto your campfire, its claws clutching a scorched parchment written in the fugitive artisan's trembling hand: '{Dost.Name} is not serving the Motherland; he is turning it into an abattoir. The Black Ledger detailing every manufactured war and staged assassination is hidden in {GizliSehir_Link}. Find the broker {KaraMuhbir_Link} before the silencers bury the truth.' Ride to {GizliSehir_Link} and locate {KaraMuhbir_Link}!

Just as {KaraMuhbir_Link} confessed, the death squad {GolgeSuikastcilar_Link} ambushed the district to silence anyone seeking the Black Ledger! Slay the assassins to survive and secure the coordinates to the cipher vault.
With the assassins broken, seek out the vault keeper {KasaKorumasi_Link} in {GizliSehir_Link} to unlock the iron casket and seize the Black Ledger.

The Black Ledger is now in your hands! Its blackened pages expose {Dost.Name} and the Scavenger Pigeons as the architects behind endless border conflicts across Calradia. Armed with the realm's deadliest blackmail, you gained 60,000 denars, 60 renown, and cemented your feared standing in the shadows.
I am looking for the one who keeps records of the shadow trade.
Keep your voice down, stranger! The street stones have ears, and silencers are lurking around every corner. Who sent you into my den?
A dying black pigeon reached me from the frontier. The fugitive artisan told me you hold the key to the Black Ledger.
You look terrified. Are you an honest broker of secrets, or another bait laid out by {Dost.Name}?
I didn't come to exchange pleasantries. Point me to the cipher archive, or I leave you to his hounds.
I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

So the artisan's bird reached someone after all... That brave fool tried to stop the war machine. What do you want from an old bookkeeper like me? Knowing what is inside that ledger is a death warrant across the whole continent!
Why a death warrant? What could be written on parchment that frightens every lord in Calradia?
How deeply is {Dost.Name} involved? Is he merely a rogue operative, or does the entire Scavenger Pigeon leadership answer to him?

It is the ledger of manufactured wars! Over forty lords from three rival kingdoms paid {Dost.Name} to assassinate legitimate heirs, poison wells, and stage border raids. {Dost.Name} orchestrates the slaughter, and the Pigeons sell both sides the intelligence to fight! The ledger is his ultimate insurance against kings.
Whoever controls this ledger holds the collar of every corrupt ruler in Calradia. Where is the vault?
If {Dost.Name} keeps such a dangerous record here, his personal guard cannot be far behind.
You're right! Curse the heavens: look past the alleyway! Shadow cloaks and drawn crossbows... An elite death squad has encircled the district! They know I've revealed the location! We are cornered!
Let them send their butchers. Today, the shadows bleed like mortals! (Draw Steel & Defend)
Shadow Silencers
Silence the witnesses! No one leaves this alley alive! For the Raven's decree!
You will need more than cheap crossbows to silence me. Draw your steel! (Fight)
The shadows bleed like mortals today! (Fight)
Barricade the inner door, old man. I will turn their ambush into their graveyard. (Fight)
The assassins outside will bother you no longer. I have come for the Black Ledger.
You cut down the elite blades like wheat... I watched from the parapet. The iron casket is right here, sealed under the mark of the Raven Bone.
What is the most damning truth recorded within these pages?
How do I know this isn't another forged deception crafted to misdirect my blade?
Enough philosophy. Crack the seals and place the casket in my custody.

Every wax seal on these sheets bears the personal crest of {Dost.Name} and the secret council. It proves that every skirmish, every raided caravan, and every slandered noble in the realm was orchestrated to siphon wealth into the Scavenger Pigeons' coffers. Whoever holds this holds the leash of Calradia's rulers.
With this ledger, {Dost.Name}'s puppet empire is finished. From now on, the shadows answer to me. (Claim the Black Ledger)
Power and gold always follow the truth. I will keep this weapon close. (Claim the Black Ledger)
Four Seasons of Service

With the traitor executed, you have proven your absolute loyalty to {Dost_Link}. The true motives of the Scavenger Pigeons remain veiled in patriotic duty. You await your seasonal orders via pigeon dispatch...
Spring Service - Espionage: A pigeon from {Dost_Link} directs you to {BaharSehir_Link}. Meet with operative {BaharOperatifi_Link} to receive decoded foreign intelligence.
The Spring espionage task was completed. As summer sweeps across Calradia, you await {Dost_Link}'s next dispatch order...
Summer Service - Courier Dispatch: Ride to {YazSehir_Link} and deliver an urgent, wax-sealed diplomatic cylinder to {YazKuryesi_Link} without breaking the seal.
The dispatch reached its destination. As autumn leaves fall, {Dost_Link} summons your martial strength for a critical frontier operation...
Hostile Deserters
Autumn Service - Combat: Hostile deserters {SonbaharHaydutlar_Link} are harassing Pigeon supply routes along the frontier. Hunt them down and eliminate them to ensure secure transit for the realm.
The border is secured. Winter's frost envelops the realm, and delicate palace affairs will soon require your discretion...
Winter Service - Court Affairs: Travel to {KisSehir_Link} and contact {KisSarayli_Link} to plant forged directives in the local registry to steer the noble council.

The four seasons of service are complete. But an unmarked black raven has arrived, directing you to meet {DerinKanatUlagi_Link}. The inner council has issued a shocking, unprecedented assassination decree: The target is none other than {Dost_Link}!

You refused to entertain the words of a traitor and struck down {DerinKanatUlagi_Link} where he stood. You rode to {Dost_Link} and reported the coup attempt within the ranks. Overwhelmed by your unyielding, incorruptible loyalty, {Dost.Name} gifted you 50,000 denars and named you his eternal champion. You remained a steadfast guardian of the Motherland.

You held your blade and listened to {DerinKanatUlagi_Link}. The documents he provided tore the veil from your eyes: {Dost_Link} has orchestrated every crisis, every border war, and every death to line his own pockets. The courier handed you the Raven Bone Cipher and directed you to the hidden sanctuary of the Shadow Roost. But {Dost.Name} already senses your defiance...
I am here on behalf of {Dost.Name}. Spring intelligence must be transferred.
The pigeon flew swiftly. The foreign garrisons are shifting patrols. Here are the decoded ciphers for {Dost.Name}.
The Motherland's eyes are everywhere. I will ensure these reach our archive.
Do these ciphers indicate an imminent attack, or just routine maneuvers?
I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
I bear a sealed cylinder from {Dost.Name} for the Summer trade convoy.
The seal is unbroken... Praise the heavens. This guarantees our caravans passage across contested borders without imperial tariff.
My duty is fulfilled. Guard those manifests well.
How does a secret society secure trade immunity from rival kings?
Winter has come. I bring the registry directives from {Dost.Name}.
Right on schedule. These forged seals will replace the tax ledgers tonight. The council will vote exactly as {Dost.Name} demands.
The four seasons of service are nearly complete. Proceed as planned.
Doesn't tampering with royal registries risk the wrath of the crown?
A black raven brought me your summons. Who are you, and what is this urgent contract?

You proved your discipline through four seasons of service, {PlayerName}. But the time for petty errands has ended. The deep wing of the Scavenger Pigeons has chosen you for the supreme task: {Dost_Link} must be executed tonight.
Why are you committing such treachery?! Don't you know what happened to the last person who gave me this mission?! I hunted that artisan down and put him to the sword!
Another assassination order against {Dost.Name}? Is this another twisted loyalty test orchestrated by the Pigeons, or have you all lost your minds?
{Dost.Name} rewarded me with gold and honor, while you whisper treason in dark corners. Give me one reason not to take your head right now.

We are desperately trying to rid the realm of the true traitor to the motherland! {Dost.Name} is the real puppeteer of fabricated wars. The artisan you killed saw the darkness coming and tried to warn you! The dispatches you carried through four seasons didn't protect peace, they sparked border clashes for his personal profit!
I served him through Spring, Summer, Autumn, and Winter! I carried dispatches, crushed deserters, planted directives. Are you saying all of it was a puppet show?!
And who gave your shadowy faction the right to pass judgment? Are you just another ambitious butcher seeking {Dost.Name}'s seat?

Yes, a puppet show of blood! The summer dispatches provoked a grain blockade, and the winter registry starved a rival loyalist clan. {Dost.Name} orchestrates every crisis so kings must grovel before the Scavenger Pigeons for information! We are the inner circle, the Shadow Council who refuse to let the Motherland burn for one man's greed!
Show me your proof. If {Dost.Name} is the monster you claim, prove it before my blade draws your blood.
Words are cheap, and traitors always cloak themselves in righteousness. Why should I believe you over {Dost.Name}?

Listen to me; do not kill me right now, and let me prove to you that you are mistaken. If you are not convinced, my neck is forfeit to your blade! Here is the Raven Bone Cipher bearing the seal of the Shadow Council. Read the orders {Dost.Name} signed in secret, then make your choice!
I swore an oath to {Dost.Name} and the Motherland. No traitor's silver tongue will sway me! Die! (Execute the Courier & Stand with {Dost.Name})
If what you say about {Dost.Name}'s false wars is true, the realm has bled for a lie. Put away your fear; show me the proof of the Shadow Council. (Spare & Listen to the Courier)
Fifty foreign deserters will fall beneath my steel. The Shadow Roost better have gold ready when I return. (Accept Mission)
If {Dost.Name} is trading with foreign powers, destroying this detachment will strike at his core. I will ride immediately. (Accept Mission)
I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{PLAYER.NAME}... You stand before me with an army at your back. Did you think I wouldn't see the shadow of the Roost looming behind you?
We were allies once, {Dost.Name}. I served you through four seasons. How long have you been playing both sides?
I know about the Black Ledger and the manufactured wars. Your web of lies has unraveled.
You brought an army to hunt me down. Is this how the Motherland treats its most loyal blade?
You call sparing a courier treason? Treason was setting Calradia on fire so your Pigeons could sell the ashes!
The courier showed me the orders you signed. You starved entire clans in winter and incited border raids in summer!

You fool... You understand nothing of statecraft! Kings and emperors are arrogant toddlers who would drown Calradia in blood for sport. The Pigeons control the flow of wars so the realm survives in balance! Without our guided hand, chaos would swallow everything!
Balance? You call slaughtering innocents balance?! You are not a protector, old friend, you are a cancer on the Motherland.
Then words are finished. The Shadow Roost will fall with you today. Knights of the Motherland, draw your steel! Slay this traitor!
For the true Calradia! Today the Motherland is freed from your poison! (Draw Steel & Charge)
Draw your sword, puppet master! No cage will save you now! (Attack)
So you are the Blind Master, the hidden phantom who birthed the Scavenger Pigeons from the shadows.
Breathe that scent deeply, old man. It is the butcher's bill for your decades of conspiracy and deceit.
I didn't scale this fortress for poetic metaphors. {Dost.Name} is dead, and the master ciphers are mine. What is your will?
I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

Deceit? No, little bird... Harmony! Calradia's monarchs are vain beasts who would drown this continent in blood for a patch of barren soil. The Shadow Roost gives their bloodlust a script. We whisper, we forge, we harvest their gold, and in return, we keep humanity from self-annihilation.
You justify starvation and border raids in the name of peace. How many innocent lives were sacrificed to write your 'script'?
You are a master of illusions who ended up deceiving yourself. You didn't stop wars; you merely industrialized them.

Ten thousand died in our border clashes so ten million wouldn't burn in a continental apocalypse! Do you think kingdoms survive on virtue? Calradia breathes because the Shadow Roost operates in the dark. Without a puppeteer, the realm descends into madness.
Then the seat of the puppeteer belongs to someone stronger. Your vision is obsolete, Master.
The world doesn't need your false gods in the dark. The realm deserves the truth, even if it burns in fire.
You speak of harmony while you orchestrated fake wars, burned frontier settlements, and starved loyal clans!
And now that the script has failed and your greatest puppet lies slain on the battlefield, what becomes of this roost?

Now comes the anvil of destiny. The throne of the Roost is empty. You can claim the Shadow Master Ring and guide the realm from behind the curtain; you can burn this nest to ashes and walk away as an unchained ghost; or you can loose the forged decrees and watch three empires tear each other to shreds!
Kings on thrones are easy to unseat, but the unseen puppeteer rules forever.
Every brick of this roost was laid with innocent blood. It deserves nothing but flame.
Why settle for ruling shadows when the entire world can be engulfed in glorious fire?
Speak your verdict, little pigeon. Calradia's crowns tremble in silence for your choice.
The Motherland's honor is preserved, and 50,000 denars is a fitting recompense. I accept. (Accept 50,000 Gold)
Gold seals our pact. May our alliance bring fortune to both of us. (Accept 50,000 Gold)
So the assassination was never an official order from the realm? I was merely a pawn in his power struggle?
I knew something smelled foul. The artisan will pay for trying to deceive me.
Who are you, and why do you hide in the shadows while {Dost.Name} parades as the savior of the Motherland?
The courier claimed you seek truth, yet here I find another ring of spies. Why should I trust your words?
I spared him because his documents were genuine. Where does the true power lie in this conspiracy?

We are the Shadow Roost, the ancient circle that founded the Scavenger Pigeons a century ago. We were born to keep greedy kings from destroying Calradia. But {Dost.Name} turned our brotherhood into his personal slaughterhouse and profit engine!
Manufactured wars... Can a single lord truly manipulate entire kingdoms into mutual slaughter for gold?
And where was this exalted Roost while {Dost.Name} traded lives? Were you blind, or simply complicit?

{Dost.Name} systematically isolated our cells and poisoned the elders who questioned his blood taxes. He hired deserters to raid frontier villages under enemy banners, forcing kings into panic so they pay fortunes for Pigeon intelligence!
The courier spoke of a foreign force. What is their role in {Dost.Name}'s grand design?
Attacking an armed foreign detachment near a mountain hideout could spark an open war with the local garrison.

A 50-man foreign detachment waits near {GolgeSiginagi_Link} to purchase {Dost.Name}'s stolen realm defense blueprints! If that intelligence crosses the frontier, thousands will burn. Slay them all. Let him find only cold steel where he expected gold!
Ah, {PlayerName}! I sent my swiftest pigeon after you. Thank the heavens we crossed paths.
Stand your ground! This mountain road belongs to us. Yield your coin or feed the crows!
You picked the wrong supply line to raid. Draw your steel! (Fight)
The Motherland's justice leaves no raiders breathing! (Fight)
Foreign Detachment
You are intruding on private negotiations, Calradian! Lower your weapons or be put down!
Those stolen defense blueprints stay on this side of the mountains! (Fight)
No foreign mercenaries buy Calradian secrets while I draw breath! (Fight)
Alley Enforcers
You butchered our boss in cold blood! None of you leave this street alive!
Your boss made his choice, and now you will join him! (Fight)
Clear the street or die where you stand! (Fight)
Roost Fanatics
Heretic! You defied the Blind Master and betrayed the Roost! Feed the crows with your flesh!
Your master was a madman, and his roost burns today! (Fight)
The Roost's lies die with you! (Fight)
